title: An unsubscribe or spam complaint also marks the contact record unsubscribed

source.ref: Contact, funnel and tracking audit 2026-11-19 (project thread: Plan a permission-first contact system)

detail:
suppress() wrote the email_suppressions row (what every send checks) but never touched contacts.consent_state. On 2026-11-19 the root Space's imported list had 15 unsubscribe suppressions but only 1 contact row marked 'unsubscribed', so Email Studio audience counts overstated reach, and any path that reads only consent_state (a segment query, an export, a future sender) would treat those people as mailable.

DONE 2026-11-19: suppress() calls markContactOptedOut for opt-out reasons (unsubscribe, complaint, flowweb_declined), scoped like the suppression (a Space-scoped opt-out updates that Space's contact rows, a global one every row with the address). Runs on both the new-row path and the already-suppressed path, so a stale record is fixed the next time it is touched. Bounces do not change consent. Best effort: the suppression row lands first, and a failed contact update is logged, never thrown. Six tests in lib/suppression.test.ts. Historical rows suppressed before this change keep a stale consent_state until a one-off backfill (aggregate: 14 imported addresses), which is a production data write left for the owner's go-ahead.

verify.note: Passes while suppress() marks the contact unsubscribed on both paths for opt-out reasons only, and the sync can never fail the suppression.
